text: Good evening. I would like to call to order the July 21st, 2026 Loudoun County Board of Supervisors business meeting. We'll start with the Pledge of Allegiance. I pledge allegiance to the flag of the United States of America and to the republic for which it stands, one nation under God, indivisible, with liberty and justice for all. All right. So we do not have a quorum in the room,

As you can see, in accordance with Rule 1.H of the Board of Supervisors' Rules of Order, tonight's meeting is being postponed to Wednesday, July 22nd at 6 o'clock p.m. Chair Phyllis Randall declared that tonight's meeting is being postponed due to hazardous weather, which prevents a quorum from being present in the boardroom.
Would anybody like to make a last comment? Supervisor Glass. Thank you, Madam Chair. I just want to send prayers for Traveling Mercies for our colleagues and staff that they return safely.

Very much, yeah. My prayers go out to them, too, that they have a safe flight back to Virginia. So with that, no other comments. I will be calling the meeting adjourned. Thank you, and we'll see you tomorrow at 6 o'clock p.m. Thank you.
